notes.title: Translation Update
notes.content: I have received feedback from valued players that some parts of the English version have not been fully translated, so I updated this part. Please note that downloading athe new version may result in the loss of previous game archives, please update carefully. I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to the players.

notes.title: 日本語バージョン延期のお知らせ
notes.content: 日本のプレイヤーには申し訳ありませんが、時間がないため、ゲームの日本語バージョンのリリースは延期されます。 しかし、私はまだ翻訳に取り組んでおり、プレイヤーのゲームの期待を失望させることはありません。 プレイヤーの皆様にはご迷惑をおかけしますことを心よりお詫び申し上げます。

notes.title: Producer Message
notes.content:
Dear players, here is the game maker Kanngi!
Phanotia I: Escavive was the first game I made, and it was completely indie, so it took quite a while. Making a game is equivalent to starting from scratch, exploring bit by bit, refining, modifying, and showing the current final version to the players.
The game definitely did not achieve the effect that players and I expected. I would like to apologize to all players and hope to be more understanding. My ability and energy are limited. If possible, I also want to make a mainstream game style, but obviously this is not something I can do alone. But I hope that all players can see my sincerity and love for game production, I want to continue to do it, and I will continue to do it. I want to turn the Phanotia series into a big Intellectual Property, so I won't be content with being an indie game producer. I am building a team (although it is only myself at the moment), I hope that all players can give me more encouragement and support for us in the future, and hereby offer my most sincere greetings and thanks.
If players are interested in the vertical painting of game characters, you can move to pixiv/Ins, search @Kanngi, and you can find the full picture of the character vertical painting. Thank you very much for your interest in the game characters. 
Players are also welcome to pay attention to me and the official account of the Phantom Team to get the latest news:

Twitter：Kanngi Yugkon Union Official
Ins：Kanngi._  yugkonunionofficial
